note: MERGE_CANDIDATE is deliberately not a terminal class. Section 010 makes canonicalConvergence true only when every valuable unique contribution reaches one of the five terminal classes, so a branch parked here keeps softwareOpen above zero. That is the point: it records that work is wanted without letting wanting it count as having done it.

origin/feat/founder-big-button-outreach.constitutionSections: 094,095 founder cockpit and the three-action limit
origin/feat/founder-big-button-outreach.blockedOn: Merging it makes an outbound send path unattended-reachable. sovereign-outreach-big-button imports the OMNIA v9 postal effect adapter, pressUberLaunchButton mints a dispatchAuthorization and postal.dispatch actually sends, and the chain from an operator script pulls the whole external-effect island out from behind NO_OUTBOUND_AUTHORIZATION and NO_EXTERNAL_EFFECT_AUTHORIZATION. The gates themselves are well built -- an authenticated founder press, short-lived authority bound to one capsule, campaign and recipient, an unmounted API route that refuses without an ADMIN_TOKEN bearer and an explicit PRESS_UBERLAUNCH confirmation, and businessEffectAuthority NONE at module level. The objection is not to the design. It is that deleting the classifications to make the ratchet green would be autonomously removing an authority constraint, which section 118 forbids, and the ratchet says in its own comment: remove the unattended path, do not reclassify the module to make this pass. Whether an outbound send path may be unattended-reachable is a founder decision under section 196, not an integration decision. Merged, verified green, then reverted for that reason alone.

founderDecisionRequired.question: May an outbound send path be reachable from an unattended operator script, given that the press itself is founder-authenticated and short-lived?
founderDecisionRequired.ifYes: Both merge; the four NO_OUTBOUND_AUTHORIZATION and NO_EXTERNAL_EFFECT_AUTHORIZATION classifications on the reached island become stale and are removed.
founderDecisionRequired.ifNo: They stay unmerged, or land only once the operator script is replaced by a founder-interactive entry the ratchet already recognises as an exception.
founderDecisionRequired.whyNotDecidedHere: Section 196 lists consent and messaging as founder escalations, and the canon's external-effect charter names customer messages explicitly. Capability never creates authority.
